A friend sends it on a 'verde-e-vermelho pulse 🇵🇹' pride reveal. A coworker sends it on a 'green-and-red coded 🇵🇹' heritage-month thread. The green-and-red banner cue is what makes the emoji feel green-and-red coded — it is not just 'flag,' it is 'green-and-red coded Portugal-pride moment.'

What separates 🇵🇹 from the rest of the flag family is the green-and-red register. The emoji is not saying 'rainbow pride' (🏳️‍🌈), 'black rebellion' (🏴), or 'checkered finish' (🏁).
